messages.author: 7c5c124542efbd3f
messages.subject: Ratio Constraints in Lavaan
parts:
I'm testing a model that uses ratio constraints on the factor loadings of a single LV measured over time. My example should make this more clear. 

model.ratio <-

'#measurement model

G1 =~ a1*T1I1 + a2*T1I2 + a3*T1I3 + a4*T1I4 + a5*T1I5

G2 =~ b1*T2I1 + b2*T2I2 + b3*T2I3 + b4*T2I4 + b5*T2I5

#ratio constraints
c == a1 / b1
c == a2 / b2
c == a3 / b3
c == a4 / b4
c == a5 / b5'

Lavaan rejects this because of my introduction of the ratio term "c" which is unspecified in the measurement model. An alternative here is manual entry of a ratio of a given size (e.g., .80) but I would rather have lavaan estimate the optimal ratio. Is there a work around to this issue? 

Thanks. everyone

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Ratio Constraints in Lavaan
parts:
Change the first instance of '==' to ':='.  With that change, your specification ran through lavaanify() with no errors when I tried it.

Keith
